title: Cut-off pull-backs along the smoothed homotopy and their limits under (PA)
statement: Let lpush_{N,N',k} : (ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) → 𝒟_k(ℝ^{N'}) be an arbitrary family of currents on univ satisfying (PA) for lpush: for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ' ∈ ℝ, every Λ-Lipschitz F : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'}, every X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞ and boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞, every sequence of C^∞ maps F_j : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} with ‖DF_j(x)‖ ≤ Λ' for all j and x ∈ spt X and F_j → F uniformly on spt X (TendstoUniformlyOn), every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N'}) and every sequence η_j ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) such that each η_j equals F_j^#ω on some open set containing spt X: X(η_j) → lpush(F, X)(ω). Let N, N', m ∈ ℕ, Λ, L ∈ ℝ≥0, F, G : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} Λ-Lipschitz, H : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} L-Lipschitz, K ⊆ ℝ^N compact with H(ι(t, x)) = F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)) for x ∈ K, t ∈ [0, 1], and ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^{N'}). Then there are test forms β_j ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^{N+1}) and ρ_{1,j}, ρ_{0,j} ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^N) (j ∈ ℕ) such that: (i) ρ_{s,j}(x)(v) = β_j(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_m) for s ∈ {1, 0} and all j, x, v; (ii) for every X ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^N) with compact support, M(X) < ∞, boundaryMassOn X univ < ∞ and spt X ⊆ K: X(ρ_{1,j}) → lpush(G, X)(ω) and X(ρ_{0,j}) → lpush(F, X)(ω); (iii) for every Y ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^{N+1}) with compact support, M(Y) < ∞, boundaryMassOn Y univ < ∞ and spt Y ⊆ C(K) := {ι(t, x) : t ∈ [0, 1], x ∈ K}: Y(β_j) → lpush(H, Y)(ω); (iv) for every such Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^{N+1}) with spt Y ⊆ C(K): Y(dβ_j) → lpush(H, Y)(dω), d = exteriorDerivativeTestOn; (v) for all j, x ∈ K and t ∈ [0, 1] there are p ∈ ℝ^{N'} and a continuous linear D : ℝ^{N+1} → ℝ^{N'} with β_j(ι(t, x)) = (ω(p)).compContinuousLinearMap D, ‖De₀‖ ≤ dist(F x, G x) + 2Λ/(j + 1) and ‖D(Jv)‖ ≤ Λ‖v‖ for all v ∈ ℝ^N.
